name: kisanvani
description: KisanVani — agri marketplace, POS and logistics platform for farmers, Market Mandis, shopkeepers and drivers

scripts.install:all: npm install && npm --prefix server install && npm --prefix client install
scripts.setup: npm run install:all && npm --prefix server run prisma:generate
scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web -c green,blue "npm --prefix server run dev" "npm --prefix client run dev"
scripts.lint: npm --prefix server run lint && npm --prefix client run lint
